summary: Railway freight overcharge claim; chargeable distance miscalculation; standard: actual engineering distance vs old distance tables; rationalization policy w.e.f. 01.01.2005; no retroactive refunds under Section 106(3) of Railways Act, 1989; overcharge not established; High Court error in ordering refund for 110 km discrepancy; appeal allowed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; restitution order reversed; no refund due for past payments.
